regeneration_command: python3 tools/project.py coverage capture --manifest tests/manifests/replay/race-crawler-dragster-3000.json --out artifacts/coverage/race-crawler-dragster-3000 && python3 tools/project.py coverage map --coverage artifacts/coverage/race-crawler-dragster-3000/coverage.json --out docs/map/race-crawler-dragster-3000.map.json --summary docs/map/race-crawler-dragster-3000.md
mapping_rule: LoROM (bsnes board LOROM-RAM#A): banks $00-$6F and $80-$EF, offsets $8000-$FFFF; ROM offset = ((bank & $7F) << 15 | (address & $7FFF)) mod ROM size
mode_notation: E/N = emulation/native; m/M = 8/16-bit accumulator; x/X = 8/16-bit index (from the pre-instruction P and E)
